title: FM3 sound specification 0.4.0 (two-row layout or general grid)

insert.description: Point-6 blocks inserted from the device-default donor; all 8 scenes start on channel A, bypassed. Mixer and Multiplexer only in grid mode; Scene MIDI (grid mode only) is placed unconnected; Volume/Pan uses volumePan.

volumePan.description: Insert captured FW13 Volume/Pan 1 VOLUME record; include volpan in the existing two-row layout.

grid.description: General 4 x 12 grid (fm3-grid.mjs). Every block in the preset must be placed; every cell must lie on an In 1/Return/Synth -> Out 1/Send path. Default input: same row, previous column.

remove.description: Grid mode only. Records removed before the grid is written; In 1, Out 1, Amp, Cab stay; Send and Return together.

duplicate.description: Grid mode only. Second/later instances seen in FW10 factory presets; copy of the previous instance with its own effect ID, all 8 scenes A/bypass.

volumePedal.description: Exact captured FW13 External 1 -> Volume/Pan 1 Gain ALL defaults in record 0. Requires volumePan:true and inactive unchanged modifier region; incompatible with active Wah. No custom Min/Max.

sceneMidi.description: Grid mode only, needs insert ["scenemidi"]. Scene MIDI commands decoded on FM3 fw 13 (2026-10-24): type PC/CC/NONE, MIDI channel 1..16, number 0..127, value 0..127 (CC only).
